summary: Randomized upstream crashchain during tenant embed backfill causing burst 5xx and elevated error-rate
description:
Issue summary: Between 2026-03-12 20:47 and 21:15 UTC we observed repeated 5xx spikes for a subset of requests to embedding upload and mixed embed+chat routes for a single dedicated tenant (SageBooks). The pattern included short-lived upstream runtime exits, observable ephemeral-proxy stalls, and a correlated increase in client-side retries resulting in sustained elevated error-rate (~6% vs baseline <0.1%).

Impact: Customer-facing failures on production tenant during background embed backfill job. Several API calls returned 502/503/504 and some streaming sessions dropped mid-session. Customer reports intermittent model-generation failures and billing-sensitive retries.

Observed behavior:
- Sudden burst of 502/503 across embed and mixed chat endpoints for tenant id sb-224.
- Ephemeral proxy CPU spike and increased queue length precede runtime exits by ~20–40s.
- Upstream runtime processes for that tenant showed SIGABRT in some cases, and others had long blocking syscalls (epoll_wait) followed by watchdog restarts.
- Retry amplification from client SDKs exacerbated proxy queueing leading to a short crashchain across multiple upstreams.

Expected behavior: Normal accept rate with <0.1% 5xx and no chained restarts during tenant background jobs.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger a tenant-initiated embedding backfill (large batched upload + concurrent chat requests) on a dedicated tenant with autoscaler warmup disabled.
Simulate mixed traffic: 60% small chat requests + 40% 1–5 MB embedding-batch uploads over a 10-minute window using client SDK retry defaults.
Observe api-gateway metrics and ephemeral-proxy queues; monitor serving-runtime watchdog logs for exits.
Note: this was reproduced in a staging mirror with the same tenant config when we applied an artificial prefetch-cancel pattern (see Investigation notes).

20:50 UTC - transient retry amplification causes proxy queueing to saturate
20:55 UTC - mitigations applied: temporarily throttle embedding ingestion for tenant
21:05 UTC - error-rate falls to baseline after stop-gap throttles and restarting affected runtime pool
comments: Ava Park (2026-03-12): Customer reported increased 5xx and mid-stream disconnects. Provided initial logs and tenant config. Asked for priority triage.
Liam Chen (2026-03-12): Acknowledged and began looking at ephemeral-proxy metrics and runtime watchdog logs. Noted nvml GPU reset entries and high proxy queue length.
Diego Martinez (SRE) (2026-03-12): Observed pinned file-descriptor growth on proxy side and hedged retry amplification from SDK clients. Suggested temporary ingestion throttle.
Support (2026-03-12): Applied temporary throttle on tenant backfill and notified customer of workaround. Requesting follow-up from runtime team for crash root cause.

Runtime Eng (2026-03-13): Reproduced a similar failure pattern in staging when prefetch cancellation plus embedding bulk uploads coincide; suspect kvcache compaction interaction with GPU driver reset. Opening PR to add safeyield around compaction loop.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: kvcache compaction interacts poorly with NVML driver on certain GPU driver versions, leading to a GPU reset that triggers runtime SIGABRTs.

Hypothesis 2: Ephemeral-proxy queue growth due to hedged retries and small-chat + embed mix causes socket stalls; stalled sockets amplify backpressure into runtime causing timeouts and watchdog triggers.
Staging reproduction: Replayed backfill + small-chat mix at 1.2x rate in staging mirror; observed identical crashchain when rapid prefetch invalidations were injected.
Metric pointers: proxy.queue_length, proxy.retransmit_count, runtime.watchdog_restarts, nvml.driver_reset_count. All showed concurrent spikes during the window.
Related config: tenant backfill had autoscaler.warmup=false and prefetch.cancel_on_error=true which increased churn.
Next steps: collect full core dump from runtime, correlate GPU driver logs from host, and add short-term runtime guard to avoid compaction during active backfill bursts.
resolution: Workaround applied: throttled tenant ingestion and reduced client SDK hedged-retries for sb-224 during backfill; restarted affected runtime pool and drained proxy queues. Medium-term fix: runtime team to land PR introducing compaction safety checks and backoff when nvml resets observed. Long-term: add tenant-level backfill pacing and circuit-breaker at proxy to avoid retry amplification. Customer was notified and accepted workaround; monitoring remains active.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-7892: Add compaction guard + NVML reset detection to serving-runtime (assigned to Runtime Eng)
OPS-4521: Implement tenant backfill pacing controls in scheduler (assigned to Scheduler team)
DOC-1210: Document recommended SDK retry settings for large embed uploads (assigned to DX)
SRE-3377: Add a proxy-level circuit-breaker to limit hedged-retry amplification per tenant
